Name: Unofficial Seasonal Cabins for Eemie's Dutch Farm Buildings
Author: Cazanna
Description:
I love [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1659]Eemiestardew's Dutch Farm Buildings[/url], but the original mod doesn't change the cabins. So I decided to make some using her sprites (like a Dr. Frankenstein mixing and matching parts I wanted to use lmao). I also changed the mailbox to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1069]Eemie's Victorian Mailbox[/url] because I thought it looked nicer than the vanilla one. Three designs are available but they don't have upgrades.

[b]To those who downloaded this mod before 13th of April 2020: I recommend downloading this mod again, I fixed the issue with the Stone Cabin not showing up.[/b]
